# Chelle Law

> > Chelle Law provides legal guidance for healthcare professionals on employment contracts, non-compete agreements, compensation, and professional licensing matters.

The firm specializes in contract review and negotiation for physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, dentists, veterinarians, and other healthcare professionals. Content covers employment law, restrictive covenants, salary negotiation, termination clauses, and professional license defense across multiple states including California and New York.

## Key Topics

- Non-compete agreements and restrictive covenants
- Physician contracts and employment terms
- Without-cause termination clauses
- Offer letter review and negotiation
- Healthcare professional compensation
- Salary negotiation strategies
- Contract breach and liquidated damages
- At-will employment in healthcare
- Malpractice tail coverage
- Independent contractor vs W2 employee status
- Notice requirements and contract termination
- Professional license defense
- CME reimbursement and benefits
- American Medical Association (AMA) guidelines
- Medical specialty compensation variations

## Employment Contracts & Restrictive Covenants

- [What is a Physician Services Agreement?](https://chellelaw.com/what-is-a-physician-services-agreement): Explains physician employment agreement essentials per AMA guidelines
- [Can Independent Contractors Be Held to a Non Compete?](https://chellelaw.com/can-independent-contractors-be-held-to-a-non-compete): Explores non-compete enforceability for independent contractors
- [Can a Company Make You Sign a Non-Compete After Employment?](https://chellelaw.com/can-a-company-make-you-sign-a-non-compete-after-employment): Addresses post-employment non-compete enforceability and employee rights
- [What is an At-Will Physician Contract? | Without Cause Termination](https://chellelaw.com/what-is-an-at-will-physician-contract): Defines at-will employment and without-cause termination for physicians
- [Penalties for Breaching Nurse Practitioner Contracts](https://chellelaw.com/penalties-for-breaching-nurse-practitioner-contracts): Reviews NP contract breach consequences and liquidated damages per AANP

## Offer Letters & Job Transitions

- [Can a Physician Back Out After Signing an Offer Letter?](https://chellelaw.com/can-a-physician-back-out-after-signing-an-offer-letter): Examines physician rights to withdraw after accepting offer letter
- [What to Expect After Signing an Offer Letter?](https://chellelaw.com/what-to-expect-after-signing-an-offer-letter): Outlines post-offer letter steps and job transition process
- [Can You Quit A Job Before Starting?](https://chellelaw.com/can-you-quit-a-job-before-starting): Covers at-will employment rights and quitting before start date implications
- [Difference Between a Veterinary Associate Offer Letter and a Contract?](https://chellelaw.com/difference-between-a-veterinary-associate-offer-letter-and-a-contract): Distinguishes veterinary offer letters from employment contracts

## Salary Negotiation & Compensation

- [Can You Negotiate Salary After an Offer?](https://chellelaw.com/can-you-negotiate-salary-after-an-offer): Guide to salary renegotiation strategies after receiving job offer
- [How Much Do Oncologists Make?](https://chellelaw.com/how-much-do-oncologists-make): Reviews oncologist salary data and compensation factors by location
- [How Much Do Radiologists Make?](https://chellelaw.com/how-much-do-radiologists-make): Analyzes radiologist compensation by specialty and geographic location
- [How Much Do Ophthalmologists Make?](https://chellelaw.com/how-much-do-ophthalmologists-make): Ophthalmologist salary guide covering compensation and career insights
- [Do Fellowships Increase Salary?](https://chellelaw.com/do-fellowships-increase-salary): Analyzes fellowship impact on physician compensation and career earnings

## Dental & Allied Health Contracts

- [Are Dental Associates Independent Contractors?](https://chellelaw.com/are-dental-associates-independent-contractors): Compares W2 employee vs independent contractor status for dental associates
- [How Long Are Most Dental Associate Contracts?](https://chellelaw.com/how-long-are-most-dental-associate-contracts): Details typical dental associate contract durations and termination terms
